therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: EGFR inhibition combined with mTOR inhibition and topoisomerase I inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation and survival pathway inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with gemcitabine resistant pancreatic cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Phase I: maximum tolerated dose; Phase II: progression-free survival

results.dose_information: Cetuximab 500 mg/m² iv biweekly, Irinotecan 180 mg/m² iv biweekly, Everolimus in daily MTD dosage

context.comparator: Capecitabine 1250 mg/m² bid and Oxaliplatin 70 mg/m² biweekly
context.duration: 18 months for Phase II primary endpoint
context.investigator_commentary: Emergence of FOLFIRINOX and slow recruitment
